correctness.rationale: Renewal gives M=(1-q)/(r q) for full-state independent resetting. The passive reflected Brownian Laplace resolvent is cosh((L-d)sqrt(r/D))/cosh(L sqrt(r/D)); its Doob tilt localizes hitting time at d/(2 sqrt(D r)) with O(r^-3/2) variance and exponentially suppresses upper-wall encounters. Stopped spatial Girsanov plus X_T=0 and zero cross variation with the OU noise yields exactly exp(-d v/(2D)) times an OU short-time exponential remainder. Bounded X and compact initial velocities control Gaussian moments on T<=r^-1/3, and discounted tails give the claimed uniform O(r^-1/4) relative error. Jensen and strict chord inequality for exp(-d v/(2D)) give sharp unique mean-constrained designs; endpoints m=a,b reduce to the same Dirac law. Independently checked the exact constant-drift Laplace ratio in log space at r=100,10000,1000000 for v=-1.5,-0.4,0,1.7, approaching exp(-dv/(2D)); independently computed mean-zero endpoint gain cosh(0.5) on [-1,1]. The source finite checker does not prove the stopped-Girsanov localization, and its delicate uniform tail bound remains a residual technical risk.
